so_what: DadKing's backfield took the week's worst hits: David Montgomery is week to week (groin), TreVeyon Henderson could miss significant time, and Zach Charbonnet is not expected back for Week 6, with KC Concepcion and T.J. Hockenson both concussed too.

pauldag's 3-2 lead now leans on Rhamondre Stevenson, who takes over New England's backfield with Henderson out, while A.J. Brown may only return to practice this week and Drake London's QB Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) awaits a Wednesday update.
Sladsous leads the league in points (701) at 2-3, which is bad luck rather than a bad roster.

James Cook's Monday (25 carries, 111 yards, two TDs, two fumbles) is a net positive for DadKing even at -2 per lost fumble: bell-cow carries plus goal-line work is the profile this 6-point-TD format pays for.
ENOTS is 3-2 on the league's weakest projected roster with 29 FAAB left.

bwalsh89's Puka Nacua drew 24 targets on Monday, but the rest of his roster is thin: Will Shipley has a partial plantar fascia tear, Ladd McConkey was emergency-only in Week 5, and Jordyn Tyson will not practice this week.
StoneBone69 (28 FAAB) and ENOTS (29) cannot chase a frenzy back, so a contested claim on Marks or Pierce is a contest between DadKing, pauldag, Sladsous and Stipe.
